digest.component_or_area: reconcile-bridge reconciler and tickets history management
propositions: Six rollout-created Jira comment duplicates (IDs 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, 997293) must be deleted and their local reconciler COMMENT events removed from Git history while preserving six preexisting survivors

Manifest-driven preparation must validate exact two-live-copy Jira state, produce deterministic Jira cleanup plan and Git rewrite candidate, and provide GET-only dry-run tooling before any external mutations
Whole-store replay and byte-level parity checks must prove that removal of 760 manifest COMMENT aliases and 254,356,959 logical bytes preserves all six survivor events and unrelated ticket state

Coordinated quiet-window execution requires GitHub Actions reconcile-bridge.yml disablement, state verification, exact Jira cleanup in canary order with append-only logging, local history rewrite with independent bundle validation, and re-enable only after non-resurrection checks

Preparation tooling must refuse before any external mutation if Jira inventory lacks one-to-one correspondence, source/ref identity drifts, pagination is incomplete, author/body/copy-count ambiguities exist, or Git bundle restore fails
